screen_susceptible: No beta-lactam resistance detected. Report susceptible to beta-lactams (cefaclor = I). No further testing required.
meningitis_resistant: Report R to benzylpenicillin, ampicillin IV and amoxicillin IV for meningitis/endocarditis and phenoxymethylpenicillin for all indications.
oxacillin_9_19: Report susceptible (no further testing) to ampicillin, amoxicillin (non-meningitis), piperacillin +/- inhibitor, cefotaxime, ceftriaxone, cefepime, carbapenems.
oxacillin_less_9: Oxacillin <9 mm. Perform full susceptibility testing for beta-lactams and interpret according to breakpoints.
